nodes.name: spin
nodes.coreScript:
-- Turns everything after it about the Z axis, so the images ring round the centre like a wheel.
-- One full turn takes 360 strobes. It only turns while animating, which the button below the ring switches on and off.
local STEP = 2 * math.pi / 360

function invoke()
    if not (getStrobe() and getAnimating()) then return end

    ANGLE = ((ANGLE or 0) + STEP) % (2 * math.pi)
    local c, s = math.cos(ANGLE), math.sin(ANGLE)

    -- Rotation about Z, in column major order.
    local t = getTransform()
    t[1] = c; t[2] = s; t[5] = -s; t[6] = c
    setTransform(t)
end

nodes.name: buttonBase
nodes.coreScript:
-- The dark housing the cap sits in.
local function faceNormal(a, b, c)
	local e1x, e1y, e1z = b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2], b[3] - a[3]
	local e2x, e2y, e2z = c[1] - a[1], c[2] - a[2], c[3] - a[3]
	local nx, ny, nz = e1y * e2z - e1z * e2y, e1z * e2x - e1x * e2z, e1x * e2y - e1y * e2x
	local len = math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz)
	if len < 1e-8 then return {0, 1, 0} end
	return {nx / len, ny / len, nz / len}
end

local function tri(a, b, c, colour, visibility)
	local n = faceNormal(a, b, c)
	local verts = {Vertex{posn = a, colour = colour, normal = n}, Vertex{posn = b, colour = colour, normal = n},
		Vertex{posn = c, colour = colour, normal = n}}
	if visibility then addVertexes(verts, visibility) else addVertexes(verts) end
end

local function quad(a, b, c, d, colour, visibility)
	tri(a, b, c, colour, visibility)
	tri(a, c, d, colour, visibility)
end

-- A cylinder about the Y axis from y0 to y1, optionally capped at either end.
local function cylinderY(y0, y1, radius, segments, colour, capTop, capBottom)
	local prevX, prevZ = radius, 0
	for i = 1, segments do
		local angle = (i / segments) * 2 * math.pi
		local x, z = radius * math.cos(angle), radius * math.sin(angle)
		quad({prevX, y0, prevZ}, {prevX, y1, prevZ}, {x, y1, z}, {x, y0, z}, colour)
		if capTop then tri({0, y1, 0}, {x, y1, z}, {prevX, y1, prevZ}, colour) end
		if capBottom then tri({0, y0, 0}, {prevX, y0, prevZ}, {x, y0, z}, colour) end
		prevX, prevZ = x, z
	end
end

function init()
	cylinderY(-5, 0, 16, 28, {58, 62, 70, 255}, true, true)
end

nodes.name: buttonLift
nodes.coreScript:
-- Presses the cap in when a press animates this node, holds it there for a moment, then lets it spring back.
local DEPRESSED = -3
local EASE = 0.35
local HOLD = 8
local held = 0

function invoke()
	if not getStrobe() then return end

	if getAnimating() then
		held = held + 1
		if held >= HOLD then
			held = 0
			setAnimating(false)
		end
	end

	local t = getTransform()
	local target = getAnimating() and DEPRESSED or 0
	local y = t[14] + (target - t[14]) * EASE
	if math.abs(target - y) < 0.05 then y = target end
	if y ~= t[14] then
		t[14] = y
		setTransform(t)
	end
end

nodes.name: buttonCap
nodes.coreScript:
-- The red cap, domed like the garden button's, with a pale ring shown while it is hovered over.
local function faceNormal(a, b, c)
	local e1x, e1y, e1z = b[1] - a[1], b[2] - a[2], b[3] - a[3]
	local e2x, e2y, e2z = c[1] - a[1], c[2] - a[2], c[3] - a[3]
	local nx, ny, nz = e1y * e2z - e1z * e2y, e1z * e2x - e1x * e2z, e1x * e2y - e1y * e2x
	local len = math.sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny + nz * nz)
	if len < 1e-8 then return {0, 1, 0} end
	return {nx / len, ny / len, nz / len}
end

local function tri(a, b, c, colour, visibility)
	local n = faceNormal(a, b, c)
	local verts = {Vertex{posn = a, colour = colour, normal = n}, Vertex{posn = b, colour = colour, normal = n},
		Vertex{posn = c, colour = colour, normal = n}}
	if visibility then addVertexes(verts, visibility) else addVertexes(verts) end
end

local function quad(a, b, c, d, colour, visibility)
	tri(a, b, c, colour, visibility)
	tri(a, c, d, colour, visibility)
end

-- A cylinder about the Y axis from y0 to y1, optionally capped at either end.
local function cylinderY(y0, y1, radius, segments, colour, capTop, capBottom)
	local prevX, prevZ = radius, 0
	for i = 1, segments do
		local angle = (i / segments) * 2 * math.pi
		local x, z = radius * math.cos(angle), radius * math.sin(angle)
		quad({prevX, y0, prevZ}, {prevX, y1, prevZ}, {x, y1, z}, {x, y0, z}, colour)
		if capTop then tri({0, y1, 0}, {x, y1, z}, {prevX, y1, prevZ}, colour) end
		if capBottom then tri({0, y0, 0}, {prevX, y0, prevZ}, {x, y0, z}, colour) end
		prevX, prevZ = x, z
	end
end

-- A dome rising from y by height, its base the given radius.
local function domeY(y, radius, height, segments, rings, colour)
	local function ringRadius(level) return radius * math.cos((level / rings) * (math.pi / 2)) end
	local function ringHeight(level) return y + height * math.sin((level / rings) * (math.pi / 2)) end
	for level = 0, rings - 1 do
		local r0, y0 = ringRadius(level), ringHeight(level)
		local r1, y1 = ringRadius(level + 1), ringHeight(level + 1)
		local prevX0, prevZ0, prevX1, prevZ1 = r0, 0, r1, 0
		for i = 1, segments do
			local angle = (i / segments) * 2 * math.pi
			local ca, sa = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
			local x0, z0, x1, z1 = r0 * ca, r0 * sa, r1 * ca, r1 * sa
			if level == rings - 1 then
				tri({prevX0, y0, prevZ0}, {0, y1, 0}, {x0, y0, z0}, colour)
			else
				quad({prevX0, y0, prevZ0}, {prevX1, y1, prevZ1}, {x1, y1, z1}, {x0, y0, z0}, colour)
			end
			prevX0, prevZ0, prevX1, prevZ1 = x0, z0, x1, z1
		end
	end
end

-- A flat ring about the Y axis at height y.
local function ringY(y, inner, outer, segments, colour, visibility)
	local prevIX, prevIZ, prevOX, prevOZ = inner, 0, outer, 0
	for i = 1, segments do
		local angle = (i / segments) * 2 * math.pi
		local ca, sa = math.cos(angle), math.sin(angle)
		local ix, iz, ox, oz = inner * ca, inner * sa, outer * ca, outer * sa
		quad({prevIX, y, prevIZ}, {ix, y, iz}, {ox, y, oz}, {prevOX, y, prevOZ}, colour, visibility)
		prevIX, prevIZ, prevOX, prevOZ = ix, iz, ox, oz
	end
end

function init()
	local red = {210, 40, 36, 255}
	cylinderY(0.5, 4.5, 10, 28, red, false, true)
	domeY(4.5, 10, 3, 28, 4, red)
	ringY(0.2, 16.5, 19.5, 28, {255, 210, 200, 140}, VertexVisibility.HOVERED_OVER)
end
nodes.pokeScript:
-- Presses the cap in, and starts or stops the ring of images turning.
if POKE_TYPE ~= "HIT" then return end
spinning = not spinning
emitAction(ActionType.ANIMATE, {animating = true}, {1})
emitAction(ActionType.ANIMATE, {animating = spinning}, {2})
